purpose: Express an urge or reaction that cannot be suppressed.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Vない + ではいられない
Whenever I hear that story, I cannot help laughing.
Seeing them struggle, I could not help offering assistance.
I am so curious about the ending that I cannot stop myself reading on.
formation: Vない + ではいられない
restrictions: Describes inner compulsion rather than an external rule.
mistake: For する, use しないではいられない.
